findings.claim: 2026-07-09 總統公告對民用飛機、噴射引擎與零件的 Section 232 不加關稅，開啟 180 天談判期，保留日後課稅選項；Commerce/USTR 須於 2027-01-05 前報告進度
findings.excerpt: Trade Representative to negotiate agreements with trading partners on imports of commercial aircraft, jet engines, and associated parts. The order imposes no new duties but opens a 180-day negotiation window and reserves the option of tariffs or other measures.

findings.excerpt: GE Aerospace to pay $36m for alleged US export breaches Updated as of: 20 April 2026 Malavika Devaya The company self-reported 116 violations over six years, including sending a Chinese supplier data on a military jet engine, the State Department’s export enforcer said in its first public settlement since 2024.

findings.claim: 2025 年 7 月美國商務部解除對 GE 向中國商飛(COMAC)出口 LEAP-1C 與 CF34 引擎的暫停
findings.source: Mexico Business News: US Lets GE Resume Jet Engine Exports to China's COMAC
findings.excerpt: The restored licenses allow GE to export LEAP-1C engines—developed through a joint venture with France’s Safran—for COMAC’s C919 narrow-body aircraft. The authorization also includes GE’s CF34 engines, which power the C909 regional jet.
